requirements.title: Typed engineering evidence graph
requirements.statement: Engineering evidence uses constrained node and edge taxonomies so invalid graph mutations can be rejected or surfaced.
requirements.positive: Create valid typed nodes/edges and traverse them; invalid discriminants are rejected.
requirements.negative: Arbitrary unregistered node/edge type strings must not silently enter canonical evidence.

requirements.title: Bidirectional trace traversal
requirements.statement: Callers can traverse from accepted product intent toward implementation/tests/evidence and reverse from artifacts/evidence toward the obligations they support.
requirements.positive: For a linked requirement→implementation→test/evidence fixture, queries in both directions recover the same relationship chain.
requirements.negative: A forward-only matrix with no reverse justification path is incomplete.

requirements.title: Bounded graph expansion
requirements.statement: Graph traversal supports explicit direction and bounded expansion so useful context can be requested without unbounded graph explosion.
requirements.positive: Query a root with a bound and receive only the allowed neighborhood with explicit truncation/continuation semantics where supported.
requirements.negative: A bounded request must not silently expand the entire reachable graph.

requirements.title: Search canonical product and evidence entities
requirements.statement: Users and agents can locate accepted product intent and relevant evidence by stable identity and supported textual/structured filters without storage-backend knowledge.
requirements.positive: Search known product/intent/evidence fixtures by ID and supported filters and recover canonical entities.
requirements.negative: Search must not silently substitute a stale historical alias for current canonical identity.

requirements.title: Explainable change impact
requirements.statement: Given a product-intent or engineering-evidence change, Tracera can identify bounded affected obligations/artifacts using explicit trace relations and explain the supporting paths.
requirements.positive: Change a linked fixture and query affected upstream/downstream nodes with paths.
requirements.negative: An impact score with no traversable supporting path must not be presented as certain impact.

requirements.title: Historical product-state query
requirements.statement: Historical accepted baselines and observations remain queryable so state can be interpreted against the contract that produced it.
requirements.positive: After a later baseline is accepted, query the prior baseline and its observations unchanged.
requirements.negative: Only-current-state storage that destroys prior accepted meaning is insufficient.

requirements.title: Explainable dissatisfaction findings
requirements.statement: Every dissatisfaction finding exposes affected product/baseline/subject, detector/rule identity, source observations, and reason sufficient to understand why it exists.
requirements.positive: Trigger a detector and inspect a finding containing subject, rule/version, evidence references, and reason.
requirements.negative: A severity/status alone with no causal evidence is not an explainable finding.

requirements.title: Human and machine semantic parity
requirements.statement: Human and machine interfaces expose the same canonical identities, baseline/status meanings, and finding semantics even when presentation differs.
requirements.positive: Inspect one product/baseline/finding through machine and human surfaces and match canonical IDs/status/explanation.
requirements.negative: A UI green state while canonical machine assessment is unknown/failed is prohibited.

requirements.title: Distilled memory provenance
requirements.statement: Enabled memory/pattern distillation retains source graph identities and confidence sufficient for audit and re-evaluation.
requirements.positive: Distill a known graph pattern and retrieve memory with source IDs and confidence.
requirements.negative: A generated memory statement with no source linkage must not be treated as canonical product intent.

requirements.title: Derived memory cannot silently revise intent
requirements.statement: Distilled or ML-derived knowledge is observational/proposed information and cannot mutate accepted intent without the explicit baseline-change workflow.
requirements.positive: Produce a high-confidence memory/recommendation and confirm accepted baseline remains unchanged.
requirements.negative: Confidence threshold alone must never authorize accepted-intent mutation.
